description: Na₅B₂P₃O₁₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one BO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.93 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.51 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.84 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids and corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.43-1.52 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid,  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.53 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.61 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.61 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom.
